label: Overview
description: A table of invoices with sortable columns, a search filter and pagination. Best for the smallest working DataTable: columns, rows and a filter.

label: Search & Filters
description: A search across two columns with a debounce, and select filters for status and type. Best for narrowing a long list from the toolbar without a server.

label: Row Actions
description: A ⋯ menu per row with view, edit, copy and a destructive delete, plus a click that opens the row. Best for records a person acts on one at a time.

label: Bulk Selection
description: Row checkboxes, select all across pages, a bulk action and a bulk delete that update the rows. Best for triage screens where many records change together.

label: Export
description: Export the selected rows, or every row, as CSV or JSON with a chosen file name and columns. Best for handing a filtered list to a spreadsheet.

label: Inline Editing
description: Cells that edit in place, written back to the record by its id so a sorted or filtered view stays right. Best for quick corrections without a form.

label: Drag to Reorder
description: Rows with a drag grip, re-anchored by id after the drop. Best for a hand-ordered list such as a document outline; dragging is pointer-only, so pair it with move actions for keyboard users.

label: Column Visibility & Pinning
description: A columns menu to hide or pin columns, remembered across reloads through a persist key. Best for wide tables where each reader wants their own view.

label: Pagination & Sorting
description: Page size choices and a sort cycle that returns to the original order on the third click. Best for long lists read page by page.

label: Mobile Cards
description: The same rows rendered as cards below the lg breakpoint, with the row actions on each card. Best for tables people also use on a phone.

label: Loading, Empty & Error
description: Tabs that switch the table between skeleton rows, a dimmed refetch, an empty state and an error. Best for checking every state a fetched table goes through.

label: Virtualised Rows
description: Two thousand rows in one scrolling body where only the rows in view are drawn. Best for large local datasets that should not be paged.

label: Server Mode
description: Paging, sorting and filtering owned by the parent, which fetches each page from a pretend server. Best for a table backed by an API that pages on the server.

label: Kitchen Sink
description: Every feature at once, as the dashboard shows it: search, filters, actions, bulk actions, export, column menu, pinning, inline editing, drag to reorder and mobile cards. Best for seeing how the features combine.
